'''Death Star II Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015). Each player drafts from three [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] and three [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] booster packs.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' 3 Endor and 3 Death Star II boosters per player
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015; events not recorded
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's [[Premiere - Death Star II Draft]] and [[Endor - Death Star II Sealed]] are separate formats)

== Card pool ==
Each player needs three Endor and three Death Star II booster packs. The format uses the guide's [[Booster Draft]] rules: players sit in groups of 4 or 6 with Light and Dark alternating, draft one card of their own side from each pack, and open packs in order of release (Endor before Death Star II).<ref name="afg" /> Deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks; the guide does not give a deck size for this format.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
After its list of sealed formats the Players Committee guide reprints [[Decipher]]'s 1999 [[Endor Draft]] rules, in which each player drafted six Endor packs into a 40-card deck.<ref name="afg" /><ref name="endorrules">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Endor Rules Supplement] (endorrules.pdf), Decipher (June 1999), "Endor Draft Tournament Rules". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Internet Archive]. Transcription: [[Endor Rulesheet]].</ref> [[DecipherCon 2002]] scheduled a "Death Star II/Endor Draft" sealed event of 4 games on 1 November 2002; whether it used the same pack mix is not stated.<ref name="swsched">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event schedule: Star Wars, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights], DecipherCon 2002, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>
